title: src/data/direct-line.json: who is on our direct line
description: One file for the archive: the people whose cards, nodes, rows and pages are tinted (is-ours). Produced from the story's ribbon by kit/tools/directline.py and held to it by kit/tools/checkfamilyribbon.py. See kit/docs/family-ribbon.md.

generationLabel.description: The noun in 'On our direct line · generation 7' (default 'generation').

people.description: One for each story ribbon card that has a person, in the ribbon's order; generation is the card's number.

unlinked.description: The ribbon cards that name no person page. They are on the line all the same, and are tinted (data-ours gen:N).

partners.description: The spouses on those cards who are themselves direct ancestors (card.spouseDirect).
